title: Hollowfall
description: A cavernous dirty bass mangled from a pitched-down 'space' sample: chopped grains are crushed, soft-driven and dragged into the sub register, while pan LFOs and a jux reverse smear it across the stereo field. Over 24 cycles the chop density, lowpass sweep, crush depth and stereo drift all travel on prime-ish clocks so the cave keeps breathing without ever resettling.
